# Parse, Don't Pray: The Case for Data Validation

> A Quarto RevealJS presentation by Indrajeet Patil.

Canonical slides: https://www.indrapatil.com/parse-dont-pray/
Full agent summary: https://www.indrapatil.com/parse-dont-pray/llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/parse-dont-pray/

Topics include current Pydantic 2.13 and Zod 4.5 validation APIs, type safety, contract testing, and safer input boundaries.
